author: Bloodyhamster69
quote: Pretty much like the budlight drama a few years back. Putting some sort of feminist woke agenda in a game meant for men. Nobody wants simp boyfriend simulator. Hopefully online is better because the side quests and polish are excellent and same with the radio content. Fire the female writers, bring back the toxic boys club because that’s the gap in the market GTA filled
